serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
OpenWater is a multi-tenant SaaS application and review platform that organizations use to run awards, abstracts and call-for-papers, grants, scholarships, fellowships, accreditation, and competition programs.

Program administrators build custom online submission forms and assign submissions to reviewers and judges for scoring and feedback.

The FedRAMP certification covers OpenWater's Submission Management and Review & Evaluation services only. Other OpenWater capabilities, including automated communications, reporting, program website builder, galleries, conference session scheduling, payments, and third-party integrations, are not included in the FedRAMP Minimum Assessment Scope.
